correctness.rationale: Two prism vertices conflict exactly at same-layer displacement ±2 or opposite-layer displacement ±1; n=3 correctly retains the triangle-induced same-layer edges and n=4 just duplicates the step of size two. The orbit of (i,t) -> (i+1,1-t) has length lcm(n,2); across its one or two orbits the conflict graph joins positions one or two steps apart. For a j-set in a cycle square the gaps are ≥3, and choosing a marked selected position counts each labeled set j times. This yields the claimed polynomial and its leading coefficient. Three colors force period three; the blocks 123 and 1234 give four colors in the other even cycle-square lengths, including the cyclic joins. The inequalities n/2 ≤ rho^o < 2n/3 for 3 not dividing n force exactly four equally sized maximum classes, hence n=4 or 8 by the stated size formulas. The repeated 1234 words realize these cases. Separate exhaustive tests of the equivalent condition |N(v) intersect S| ≤ 1 for every v checked all 21,824 subsets for n=3–7 against every coefficient (python /workspace/independent_checks.py 3); they supplement, not establish, the all-n argument.
